an5.52:1.1: “Bhikkhus, saying ‘a heap of the unwholesome,’ it is about the five hindrances that one could rightly say this.
an5.52:1.2: For the five hindrances are a complete heap of the unwholesome.
an5.52:1.4: The hindrance of sensual desire, the hindrance of ill will, the hindrance of dullness and drowsiness, the hindrance of restlessness and remorse, and the hindrance of doubt.
an5.52:1.5: Bhikkhus, saying ‘a heap of the unwholesome,’ it is about these five hindrances that one could rightly say this.
an5.52:1.6: For these five hindrances are a complete heap of the unwholesome.”
